description: This file 'subs_vector.h' defines data structures and function prototypes for managing a vector of subscription objects ('subs_t') in a C project. It includes definitions for the subscription element, the vector container, and API functions for initializing, adding, removing, and cleaning up subscriptions. The file also defines the structure of each subscription, including various fields related to subscription parameters, such as enable flags, IDs, notification types, expiry times, and associated parameter vectors.

methods.name: SUBS_VECTOR_Init
methods.description: Initializes a subscription vector structure before use.

methods.name: SUBS_VECTOR_Add
methods.description: Adds a new subscription to the subscription vector.

methods.name: SUBS_VECTOR_Remove
methods.description: Removes a subscription from the vector.

methods.name: SUBS_VECTOR_Destroy
methods.description: Destroys the entire subscription vector and frees associated resources.

methods.name: SUBS_VECTOR_DestroySubscriber
methods.description: Frees resources associated with a single subscription object.

methods.name: SUBS_VECTOR_GetSubsByInstance
methods.description: Retrieves a subscription by its instance number.

methods.name: SUBS_VECTOR_MarkSubscriptionForDeletion
methods.description: Marks a subscription for deletion at a later time.

methods.name: SUBS_VECTOR_GarbageCollectSubscriptions
methods.description: Removes and frees subscriptions marked for deletion.

methods.name: SUBS_VECTOR_Dump
methods.description: Outputs the current state of the subscription vector for debugging.
